scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis paperless sync-worker
scripts.dev:infra:build: docker compose up -d --build postgres redis paperless sync-worker
scripts.db:push: cd app && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && npx prisma db push --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma && NODE_PATH=./node_modules npx tsx --env-file=.env.local ../prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:studio: cd app && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && npx prisma studio --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
